description: Third-party frontend assets vendored into the Web Console (issue #36). Each file is byte-identical to the file of the same path in the npm registry tarball named here, which was verified against the registry's published integrity. verify_repository_policy.py checks every vendored file against its sha256, requires each package's license file, and requires the Console's pinned subresource integrity to match; verify_frontend_asset_sources.py (CI) downloads each tarball, checks its sourceIntegrity, and compares every vendored file with its tarball member. Never load these from a CDN at runtime.

packages.name: htmx.org
packages.copyright: none stated; the 0BSD license requires no notice

files.note: The source map the stylesheet's sourceMappingURL names, vendored so the stylesheet stays byte-identical to the tarball.
